### Compounded Semaglutide (Telehealth) (Semaglutide + B12 (Cyanocobalamin))
- **Page URL**: https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/drugs/compounded-semaglutide
- **Drug Classification**: Telehealth (Weight Loss & GLP-1)
- **Manufacturer**: FDA-Regulated 503A/503B Compounder
- **Standard Dosage**: Monthly Supply (Tailored Dose) (Subcutaneous Injectable Vial)
- **Brand Price**: $948.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $199.00 (Save 79%)
- **FDA Indications**: Chronic weight management in adults with BMI >= 30, or BMI >= 27 with at least one weight-related comorbid condition.
- **Contraindications**: Pregnancy, history of pancreatitis, thyroid cancer risk.
- **How to Use**: Inject weekly with sterile micro-needle as prescribed by your online physician.
- **Side Effects**: Mild transient nausea.
- **Clinical Overview**: Affordable compounded semaglutide formulated by licensed US 503A/503B state-board pharmacies through telehealth platforms (Ro, Hims). Includes physician consult and home delivery.

### Ozempic (Brand Pen) (Semaglutide Injection)
- **Page URL**: https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/drugs/ozempic
- **Drug Classification**: Rx (Weight Loss & GLP-1)
- **Manufacturer**: Novo Nordisk
- **Standard Dosage**: 2mg/3mL (0.5mg or 1mg weekly dose) (Prefilled Subcutaneous Pen)
- **Brand Price**: $948.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $299.00 (Save 68%)
- **FDA Indications**: Type 2 Diabetes mellitus; off-label for chronic weight management and obesity.
- **Contraindications**: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
- **How to Use**: Inject subcutaneously once weekly in abdomen, thigh, or upper arm on the same day each week.
- **Side Effects**: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, constipation (especially when escalating dose).
- **Clinical Overview**: A weekly GLP-1 receptor agonist that slows stomach emptying, reduces hunger cravings, and significantly regulates blood sugar levels.

### Atorvastatin (Generic Lipitor) (Atorvastatin Calcium)
- **Page URL**: https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/drugs/atorvastatin
- **Drug Classification**: Rx (Cholesterol & Heart)
- **Manufacturer**: Teva / Sandoz Generics
- **Standard Dosage**: 20mg, 30 tablets (Oral Tablet)
- **Brand Price**: $185.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $7.20 (Save 96%)
- **FDA Indications**: Primary hyperlipidemia, cardiovascular risk reduction in adults.
- **Contraindications**: Severe hepatic impairment, pregnancy, hypersensitivity to atorvastatin.
- **How to Use**: Take 1 tablet daily. Routine lipid panel tests recommended every 6 to 12 months.
- **Side Effects**: Occasional mild muscle soreness.
- **Clinical Overview**: Direct FDA-approved generic equivalent of Lipitor. Contains identical active ingredient, potency, bioequivalence, and safety profile at 96% lower retail cost.

### Viagra (Brand) (Sildenafil Citrate)
- **Page URL**: https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/drugs/viagra
- **Drug Classification**: Rx (Men's Health)
- **Manufacturer**: Viatris / Pfizer
- **Standard Dosage**: 50mg, 10 tablets (Blue Film-Coated Tablet)
- **Brand Price**: $780.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $18.00 (Save 98%)
- **FDA Indications**: Erectile dysfunction (ED) in adult males.
- **Contraindications**: Never use with organic nitrates (nitroglycerin for heart conditions) or riociguat due to dangerous blood pressure drops.
- **How to Use**: Take 1 tablet approximately 30 to 60 minutes before sexual activity. Works up to 4 to 6 hours.
- **Side Effects**: Facial flushing, headache, nasal congestion, indigestion.
- **Clinical Overview**: The iconic phosphodiesterase type 5 (PDE5) inhibitor that increases blood flow to the penis during sexual stimulation.

### Zoloft (Brand) (Sertraline Hydrochloride)
- **Page URL**: https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/drugs/zoloft
- **Drug Classification**: Rx (Mental Health & Mood)
- **Manufacturer**: Pfizer Inc.
- **Standard Dosage**: 50mg, 30 tablets (Oral Tablet)
- **Brand Price**: $115.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $7.90 (Save 93%)
- **FDA Indications**: Major depressive disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder, panic disorder, posttraumatic stress disorder, social anxiety disorder.
- **Contraindications**: Concomitant use of monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) or pimozide.
- **How to Use**: Take once daily in morning or evening. Do not stop abruptly without tapering.
- **Side Effects**: Dry mouth, insomnia, mild gastrointestinal upset during initial 2 weeks.
- **Clinical Overview**: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) that restores neurotransmitter chemical balance in the brain to treat depression and major anxiety disorders.

### Zyrtec (Brand 24-Hr) (Cetirizine Hydrochloride)

- **Manufacturer**: Johnson & Johnson Kenvue
- **Standard Dosage**: 10mg, 30 tablets (Oral Tablet)
- **Brand Price**: $28.99
- **Generic Cash Price**: $6.99 (Save 76%)
- **FDA Indications**: Relief of outdoor and indoor allergy symptoms and chronic urticaria (itchy rash).
- **Contraindications**: Severe end-stage renal impairment.
- **How to Use**: Adults: take one 10mg tablet once daily with water. Do not exceed recommended dosage.
- **Side Effects**: Rare mild drowsiness in sensitive individuals.
- **Clinical Overview**: Second-generation non-drowsy antihistamine that blocks histamine release from pollen, pet dander, dust mites, and mold.

### Lipitor (Brand) (Atorvastatin Calcium)
- **Page URL**: https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/drugs/lipitor
- **Drug Classification**: Rx (Cholesterol & Heart)
- **Manufacturer**: Pfizer Inc.
- **Standard Dosage**: 20mg, 30 tablets (Oral Tablet)
- **Brand Price**: $185.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $8.90 (Save 95%)
- **FDA Indications**: Hypercholesterolemia, prevention of cardiovascular disease, reduction of risk of stroke and myocardial infarction.
- **Contraindications**: Active liver disease, unexplained persistent elevations in hepatic transaminases, pregnancy, and nursing mothers.
- **How to Use**: Take once daily at the same time every day, with or without food. Avoid excessive intake of grapefruit juice.
- **Side Effects**: Mild muscle ache, joint pain, diarrhea, and slight increase in blood sugar levels.
- **Clinical Overview**: Lipitor is an FDA-approved HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin) used to lower bad cholesterol (LDL) and triglycerides in the blood, while increasing good cholesterol (HDL).

### Ventolin HFA (Albuterol Sulfate)
- **Page URL**: https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/drugs/ventolin-hfa-90mcg-inhalation-aerosol
- **Drug Classification**: Rx (Respiratory & Asthma)
- **Manufacturer**: GSK / Teva
- **Standard Dosage**: 90mcg Inhalation Aerosol (Metered Dose Inhaler)
- **Brand Price**: $74.00
- **Generic Cash Price**: $19.50 (Save 74%)
- **FDA Indications**: Acute relief of bronchospasm or prevention of exercise-induced bronchospasm.
- **Contraindications**: Hypersensitivity to albuterol.
- **How to Use**: 2 inhalations every 4 to 6 hours as needed.
- **Side Effects**: Tremors, fast heart rate.
- **Clinical Overview**: Fast-acting bronchodilator rescue inhaler that relaxes airway muscles.

### Prilosec OTC (Brand) (Omeprazole Delayed-Release)
- **Page URL**: https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/drugs/prilosec-otc
- **Drug Classification**: OTC (Acid Reflux & GERD)
- **Manufacturer**: Procter & Gamble
- **Standard Dosage**: 20mg, 42 tablets (3x 14-day courses) (Delayed-Release Tablet)
- **Brand Price**: $27.50
- **Generic Cash Price**: $9.90 (Save 64%)
- **FDA Indications**: Frequent heartburn occurring 2 or more days a week.
- **Contraindications**: Trouble or pain swallowing food, vomiting with blood, or bloody/black stools (see doctor immediately).
- **How to Use**: Take 1 tablet every morning before eating for 14 days. Do not chew or crush.
- **Side Effects**: Headache, stomach pain, diarrhea.
- **Clinical Overview**: Proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that shuts down excess stomach acid pumps at the source for round-the-clock 24-hour relief from painful heartburn.

### Advil Liqui-Gels (Brand) (Ibuprofen Solubilized)
- **Page URL**: https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/drugs/advil
- **Drug Classification**: OTC (Pain & Inflammation)
- **Manufacturer**: Haleon US
- **Standard Dosage**: 200mg, 80 capsules (Liquid Filled Capsule)
- **Brand Price**: $15.99
- **Generic Cash Price**: $4.49 (Save 72%)
- **FDA Indications**: Temporary relief of minor aches, pains, headaches, and fever reduction.
- **Contraindications**: Active stomach ulcers, bleeding disorders, severe heart disease, or during third trimester of pregnancy.
- **How to Use**: Adults: take 1 to 2 capsules every 4 to 6 hours while symptoms persist. Do not exceed 6 capsules in 24 hours.
- **Side Effects**: Mild stomach upset (take with food or milk to minimize).
- **Clinical Overview**: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) designed to target the site of inflammation and rapidly block pain signals.
